scope: Two new actual headless navigation regressions plus one affected actual coordinator submission case. Historical browser receipts remain unchanged.
command: node --test --test-name-pattern 'actual headless Edge fills|navigation during final semantic check' tests/method-browser.test.cjs

privatePrerequisites.TRACE_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE: <absolute installed Playwright module directory outside checkout>

regressionBeforeFix.actual: Allowed replacement was submitted to the fixture result route. Outside-scope replacement still called the Playwright click mutator once. These were actual owned Page navigations during the final awaited isEnabled check; no user browser profile or native desktop input was used.

cases.name: actual headless Edge fills, submits, reads and verifies once after lost reply
navigation during final semantic check blocks allowed replacement before mutation
navigation during final semantic check blocks outside replacement before mutation

limits: The provider supplies no atomic transaction with page JavaScript or navigation; it rechecks actual page/capture identity after awaited validation and immediately before consuming evidence.
The regression uses wrappers around actual public Playwright Page/Locator methods only to trigger controlled real navigation and count mutator invocations.
This is owned loopback headless-browser acceptance, not native GUI or independent model-host workflow acceptance.
The two unaffected prior browser cases were not rerun; original and exact-binding receipts keep their own historical hashes.
